t: Four things to seek refuge from
a: تَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلاَءِ، وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ، وَسُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاءِ
p: Aʿūdhu billāhi min jahdi-l-balā', wa daraki-sh-shaqā', wa sū'i-l-qaḍā', wa shamātati-l-aʿdā'.
m: I seek refuge in Allah from the strain of trial, from being overtaken by wretchedness, from an evil outcome, and from the gloating of enemies.
